payload.intro: A number expressed as the product of a number with itself is a square.
whatYoullLearn: A number expressed as the product of a number with itself is a square.

blocks.text: In this part of the unit, we explore the properties of perfect squares and their patterns. We also learn different methods to calculate square roots, like repeated subtraction.

items: A number expressed as the product of a number with itself is a square.

steps.explanation: Subtract the first odd number from 81.
Subtract the next odd number, 3, from the result.
Since we reached zero in 9 steps, the square root is 9.
First, find the prime factors of 324.
Group the identical prime factors into pairs.
Check if every factor has a partner to form a pair.
Take one number from each pair and multiply them.
Since we can group them perfectly, it is a square.
